title: Accounts and Finance Officers
description:
**ACCOUNTS AND FINANCE PROFESSIONALS**

**BACKGROUND**  
We are a 23\-yr young, decorated NGO working to empower the poor and unite people using rationality, everyday science and technology. Amongst our funders/patrons are Microsoft, Google, AutoDesk, Ford Foundation, US and Gujarat Governments, two former PMs, a DyPM, eminent jurists, writers and activists. With their help we served some 1\.5 million users. Interns and trainees have come to us from prestigious Indian universities and some from around the world.

We have vacancies in accounts, finance, and admin at HO at Paldi, Ahmedabad, and mostly at TARKIK SADAN, \[Google: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9McTAeys8uAQb1Tn7]

a serene campus at Matar 40 KMs from Ahmedabad. We seek professionals at 3 levels.

**POSITIONS** \[Following compensations are net outflows. CTC would be higher.]

1\. **Jr Accountants**: \[1\-2].

* Compensation to range between Rs. 1\.8 – 2\.5 L/PA;
* B. Com / BBA or equivalent.
* Min 1\-yr exp on FAS in a professional set\-up;
* Besides accounting, cash, documentation, assisting in admin and housekeeping.
* Functional English and Hindi/Gujarati and Excel required.
* Location A] At Ahmedabad office, or b] At Matar with subsidized boarding and lodging.

2\. **Accounts Officer**:

* Compensation to range between Rs. 2\.0\-3\.5 L/PA;
* M.Com / MBA / Inter CA or equivalent.
* Min 2\-yr exp in accounts including 1\-yr in finance function, of which at least 1 yr in supervisory role, in a professional set\-up
* Solid Accounting, basic finance, admin, HR, Promotion.
* Proficient in English, Excel and one FAS.
* Posting at Matar with subsidized boarding and lodging.

3\. **Finance Manager**:

* Posting at Matar with subsidized boarding and lodging.
* Compensation to range between Rs. 3\.0\-4\.5 L/PA;
* Masters in Finance or equivalent.
* Min 3\-yr officers exp in finance including at least 1 yr in resource mobilization in a professional set\-up;
* Proven track record in fund raising, basic statutory compliances,
* Additional roles: HR, Administration, Costing, Public Relations, IT applications, Elementary AI and generally a multi\-tasker
* Posting At Matar with subsidized boarding and lodging.
* Suitable Employment for Spouse possible.

**BENEFITS**

Annual Compensation grows in monthly increments. Systematic and transparent work assessment and reward/punishment policy. Employment for the **spouse** is possible. Ideal for outstation candidates. \[Freshers please check below]

We offer a highly learning, intellectual, secular and inspirational work environment with immense work satisfaction and complete transparency. Since rationalists do not believe in the hereafter, we try to make this world – and this campus – happier for us, and for you.

Come, learn, earn, have fun and serve the society \- all together!

**ELIGIBILITY:** You should

* Be absolutely secular with left\-liberal ideological values.
* Be Dexterous with Tally or Busy
* Possess suitable understanding of book\-keeping and accounts, business processes and statutory requirements.
* Know good MS Excel, and functional Word, surfing and mailing.
* Be meticulous and a stickler for procedures, protocols and systems and should be punctual and diligent.
* Be courteous yet firm, affable yet discrete, accessible but also reserved and dignified.

**Extras**   
We may also consider providing a suitable employment for the spouse. And subsidized boarding and lodging for all residents on the campus.

Proven capabilities in innovative fund sourcing from national / international corporates, CSR, NGOs, developmental agencies, UN affiliates, social media supported fund raising, personal patronage and sourcing from good Samaritans and philanthropists will earn you **higher grade**, pay and perks.

**FOR FRESHERS**  
For inexperienced candidates a 3\-month internship with FREE food and accommodation is available at Matar or at Ahmedabad HO. On satisfactory completion a guaranteed regular job will be offered in a suitable grade commensurate with education and experience.

You must be a bright graduate. Must speak and write correct English. Should be very good at any of these: Accounting; Finance; HR; Horticulture; IT Applications; AI; Videography; Content Writing; Graphics; Animation; Anchoring; Marketing; Social Media etc

**APPLICATION**  
To know us better please browse through this PPt Introduction: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=\_gzCPnAKpVE

And to understand the range of our services please check this out: Https://sprat.in/programs\-campaigns/servicesmasterlist/

**NOTE:** \[Exceptionally, you may contact us through inquiry{at}sprat{dot}in \[with subject line marking for the President] ONLY if you have an outstanding record of performance in any of our listed services. Casual applicants will be blacklisted

Please specify the position / grade for which you are applying. Check this write\-up carefully. Do ANSWER the questions asked below. And after applying please CHECK our mail / message in Indeed message box.

And if shortlisted please fill in our proforma on\-line Web Application Form.

We sincerely wish you health, peace and joy

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹450,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment

Application Question(s):

* 1\. Please rank your proficiency in the following as High \[H], or Medium \[M] or Low \[L]:

a: Double Entry book keeping; b: Resource Mobilization; c: English spoken, d: English written, e:Excel, f: HR recruitment; g: Admin and Housekeeping; 

* 2\. Please specify the Position / Grade for which you are applying, and will be examined, and mention your qualifying education against it
* 3\. Please confirm that you are secular and liberal and value scientific temper and rationality? \[We do not want fanatics and too conservative people]
* 4\. Most positions are for Matar at our serene campus where subsidized accommodation and food are provided, along with recreational facilities. Please confirm that you will be living on the campus and will follow normal campus discipline.

Work Location: In person

title: Accounting Administrator
description:
**Position:** Accounts \& Administration Executive  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Accounts \& Administration

About the Role

We are looking for a **detail\-oriented, organized, and responsible Accounts \& Administration Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting, GST and taxation activities along with office administration, documentation, coordination, and operational support.

The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of **Tally, GST, ITR, bookkeeping, MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint**, and basic AI productivity tools.

Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts \& Finance

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting and bookkeeping activities.
* Maintain accounts and financial records using **Tally ERP / Tally Prime**.
* Prepare and maintain **Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, ledgers, trial balance**, and other financial reports.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, invoices, payments, receipts, and bank reconciliation.
* Maintain proper records of expenses, purchases, sales, and financial transactions.
* Assist in preparing monthly and periodic financial reports.
* Maintain and organize financial documents and supporting records.

GST \& Taxation

* Handle routine **GST\-related accounting and compliance activities**.
* Assist in preparation and filing of **GST returns**.
* Maintain GST invoices, input tax credit records, and reconciliation.
* Assist with **ITR preparation and filing**.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, tax consultants, auditors, and other professionals when required.
* Maintain proper documentation for tax and statutory requirements.

Administration \& Office Management

* Manage day\-to\-day **office administration and operational activities**.
* Maintain company records, documents, bills, invoices, agreements, certificates, and administrative files.
* Maintain proper physical and digital filing systems.
* Coordinate with **vendors, banks, Chartered Accountants, auditors, government departments, clients, and service providers**.
* Handle office purchases, stationery, supplies, and vendor follow\-ups.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records, and basic employee documentation.
* Support recruitment coordination, interview scheduling, joining documentation, and other basic HR administrative activities.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, official visits, and other office requirements.
* Prepare and maintain **MIS reports, trackers, databases, and administrative reports**.
* Prepare **PowerPoint presentations** and other documents for management meetings, proposals, reports, and internal communication.
* Handle official emails, letters, notices, and other business correspondence.
* Assist management with day\-to\-day administrative and operational requirements.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on pending administrative and documentation\-related tasks.

Digital Tools \& AI

* Use **MS Excel** for data management, reporting, trackers, and basic analysis.
* Prepare professional documents using **MS Word**.
* Prepare professional **PowerPoint (PPT) presentations** for meetings, reports, proposals, and business requirements.
* Use **Google Sheets / Google Workspace** for documentation and collaboration.
* Use simple **AI tools such as ChatGPT** for drafting, research, documentation, data organization, and improving day\-to\-day productivity.
* Willingness to learn and adopt new digital tools and software.

Required Skills

* Good working knowledge of **Tally Prime / Tally ERP**.
* Practical knowledge of **GST, ITR, bookkeeping, and taxation**.
* Understanding of basic accounting principles.
* **Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and PowerPoint.**
* Ability to prepare professional **PPT presentations, reports, and business documents**.
* Good knowledge of **Google Sheets / Google Workspace**.
* Basic knowledge of **AI tools such as ChatGPT** for productivity and documentation.
* Strong documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational abilities.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple accounting, administrative, and operational tasks.

Qualification

* **B.Com / equivalent qualification** preferred.
* **1–2 years of relevant experience** in Accounts \& Administration.
* Candidates with practical experience in **Tally, GST, taxation, and office administration** will be preferred.

Key Attributes

* Responsible, organized, and disciplined.
* Accurate and detail\-oriented.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Comfortable working with **Excel, Word, PPT, and digital tools**.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and AI\-based productivity tools.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of company and financial information.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst | Onestream: All | Ahmedabad | Finance Transformation | Business Finance
description:
**Analyst \| Onestream: All \| Ahmedabad \| Finance Transformation \| Business Finance**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 113246
* **Location**: Ahmedabad
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**



Enterprise technology must do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long\-term growth. Learn more about ET\&P


**Key Responsibilities**


* Gather and analyze business requirements related to **financial planning, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, and management information**.
* Configure and develop solutions within OneStream based on business requirements.
* Develop and maintain **Cube Views, Dashboards, Forms, Workflow Profiles, Data Management Sequences, and Business Rules**.
* Develop and maintain OneStream **Business Rules using VB.NET**.
* Write and optimize **SQL queries** for data extraction, validation, troubleshooting, and reporting requirements.
* Support the development and maintenance of **data integrations and data loads** from source systems into OneStream.
* Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data.
* Support the design and maintenance of **OneStream dimensions, hierarchies, scenarios, workflows, and application metadata**.
* Develop user\-friendly dashboards and reports to meet business and management reporting requirements.
* Troubleshoot application, calculation, workflow, data load, and reporting issues.
* Analyze production issues and perform **root\-cause analysis** to identify and resolve defects.
* Execute unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, and support user acceptance testing.
* Prepare technical and functional documentation for new developments and enhancements.
* Support application deployments across development, test, and production environments.
* Assist with **OneStream application maintenance, upgrades, and performance optimization**.
* Work with senior analysts, consultants, and managers to deliver enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Provide production support and respond to user queries and incidents.
* Follow development standards, testing procedures, change\-management processes, and application security guidelines.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the efficiency of existing OneStream solutions.


**Technical Skills**


* Hands\-on experience with **OneStream XF**.
* Good understanding of **OneStream architecture and application components**.
* Experience with:
* Cube Views
* Dashboards
* Business Rules
* Data Management
* Workflow
* Forms
* Member Lists
* Parameters
* Scenario Management
* Security
* Extensible Dimensionality
* Working knowledge of **VB.NET** and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong knowledge of **SQL Server and SQL queries**.
* Understanding of OneStream APIs such as **BRApi** and their application within Business Rules.
* Experience with data integration, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Ability to troubleshoot OneStream calculations, data loads, workflows, and application errors.


**Functional Skills**


* Understanding of **FP\&A and financial reporting processes**.
* Knowledge of budgeting and forecasting processes.
* Understanding of financial consolidation and reporting.
* Knowledge of P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and management reporting.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Understanding of financial data structures, dimensions, hierarchies, and business rules.
* Experience working with Finance, FP\&A, Accounting, and Controllership teams is preferred.


**Required Experience**


* **2–5 years of experience** in OneStream, EPM, FP\&A systems, financial systems, or a related technology area.
* Hands\-on experience in OneStream development and application support.
* Experience developing or maintaining OneStream Business Rules, Cube Views, Dashboards, and Data Management processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with functional and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple development and support activities simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* OneStream certification or relevant OneStream training.
* Experience with OneStream implementation or enhancement projects.
* Experience with ERP systems such as **SAP, Oracle, or other financial source systems**.
* Experience with financial data integrations.
* Exposure to **Account Reconciliations, Transaction Matching, or other OneStream solutions**.
* Experience working in an Agile or structured application\-development environment.


**Key Competencies**


* Analytical and detail\-oriented approach.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Good understanding of finance and technology.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Effective communication with technical and business stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn new OneStream functionality and continuously improve technical skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced project and production\-support environment.

title: Analyst - Accounts Receivables
description:
Job Description
**Analyst**


**Role Overview**


Designation Title: Analyst \- Accounts Receivable


Department: Finance \& Accounts


Business Unit: Arvind GCC


Group Company: Arvind Global Capability Centre Pvt Limited


Location: Ahmedabad


Work Mode: Onsite


**About Arvind Global Capability Centre Pvt Limited**


Arvind GCC is a new\-age, technology\-enabled capability centre being built to power the next chapter of growth for the Arvind Group. Going beyond the traditional shared\-services model, the GCC will bring together exceptional talent, technology, and operational excellence to enable businesses across the Arvind ecosystem.


As a new\-age organization within the Arvind ecosystem, the GCC brings together global talent, contemporary technology, and a culture of innovation and collaboration. It offers an opportunity to work on meaningful, enterprise\-scale challenges while helping shape the capabilities, culture, and future of a GCC being built for long\-term impact.


**Role Summary**


Analyst – Accounts Receivable (O2C) in Finance \& Accounts, supporting end\-to\-end Order to Cash operations within a Shared Services environment.


* Responsible for accurate cash application, collections support, customer account management, reconciliations, and billing\-related coordination.
* This role is suited to a detail\-oriented, energetic professional who can work independently, manage high\-volume transactions, and contribute to process improvement in a digital transformation environment.
* Graduate in Commerce/Accounting (B.Com) or equivalent, with 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in Accounts Receivable or Order\-to\-Cash operations.
* Preferred hands\-on experience working with SAP (FI/SD – AR).

**Key Responsibilities**


* Perform accurate and timely cash application in SAP, matching incoming receipts to customer invoices and handling on\-account, unapplied, and advance receipts in line with policy and SLAs.
* Support collections activities by following up on overdue invoices with customers and internal stakeholders, and maintaining clear records of communication and commitments.
* Process and track customer deductions, short payments, and disputes, including logging, investigating, and routing issues for resolution with sales, logistics, and finance teams.
* Perform periodic customer account reconciliations and follow up on unallocated credits, advances, and debit balances for timely clearing.
* Support billing and invoicing activities, ensuring accuracy of invoice value, tax details, and customer information.
* Manage customer queries regarding statements, payment status, and account balances with a high level of customer service.
* Proactively flag recurring errors, unapplied cash trends, aging build\-ups, or system issues to support continuous process improvement.
* Maintain accurate documentation, records, and trackers in line with defined controls, timelines, and shared services processes.

**Must\-Have Skills**


* Graduate in Commerce/Accounting (B.Com) or equivalent
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in Accounts Receivable or Order\-to\-Cash operations
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and the receivables lifecycle
* Cash application
* Collections support
* Customer account reconciliation
* Billing and invoicing support
* Invoice and payment reconciliation
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently in a structured Shared Services environment
* Basic understanding of Indian statutory deductions applicable to receivables, such as GST and TDS/TCS

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* Preferred hands\-on experience working with SAP (FI/SD – AR)
* Experience with customer deductions, short payments, and dispute handling
* Exposure to unallocated credits, advances, and debit balance clearing
* Familiarity with process improvement and issue trend analysis
* Customer follow\-up and stakeholder coordination

**What We Offer**


* 5\-Day Work Week \& Flexible Hours
* Hybrid Work Flexibility
* Comprehensive Health \& Wellness Benefits
* Learning, Certifications \& Career Growth Opportunities
* Internal Mobility Across the Arvind Group
* Inclusive \& Employee\-Centric Culture
* Employee Discounts and Corporate Travel Benefits

**Application Consent**


By applying for this role, you consent to Arvind Limited processing your application and personal information for recruitment purposes. If shortlisted, you may receive calls or other recruitment\-related communications from Veda, our AI\-powered recruitment assistant, for interview scheduling, screening, and hiring updates.

* Stakeholder coordination
* Record maintenance and audit readiness

* Process compliance

### **About us**


We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized Account professional to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations and ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial records. The role will be responsible for bookkeeping, invoicing, Accounts Payable and Receivable, reconciliations, statutory compliances, MIS reporting, and financial documentation. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with Tally Prime, GST, TDS, and MS Excel, along with a strong understanding of accounting principles. You will work closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and external accountants/auditors to ensure smooth financial operations and timely closure of accounting activities.


### **Roles \& responsibilities**


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date financial and accounting records.
* Manage day\-to\-day accounting transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts, and payments.
* Prepare and process client invoices, billing documents, and payment follow\-ups.
* Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Perform regular bank, vendor, and client reconciliations.
* Handle GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Maintain records and documentation required for audits and taxation.
* Prepare MIS reports and basic financial statements.
* Track expenses, reimbursements, and employee\-related financial transactions.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, clients, and external accountants/auditors when required.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure timely closure of accounting activities.
* Support management with financial data and reports as required.
### **Skills required**


* Strong knowledge of Accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Hands\-on experience with Tally Prime.
* Good understanding of GST and TDS.
* Knowledge of Accounts Payable \& Receivable.
* Experience in Bank Reconciliation and Invoicing.
* Good command of MS Excel, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and basic formulas.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
